explained.histogram: the Qt dock header 'Histogram' (and its tab): the emtk dock is titled '📊 Micro-time histograms' and draws the same plot
explained.level: the Qt toolbar label 'Level:' is the spec field 'Trigger level' (same count threshold, same auto-align)
explained.pos: the Qt toolbar label 'Pos:' is the spec field 'Target bin' (same bin, same auto-align)
explained.showtrigger: the Qt toolbar toggle 'Show Trigger' is the spec toggle 'Show trigger lines'
